newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong 5-year notes to be tendered Sept 16.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong 5-year notes to be tendered Sept 16.

text.p: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) said on Monday it would tender HK$500 million in five-year notes on September 16, for settlement the following day.
It said another HK$100 million of notes would be held as reserve by the HKMA for supplying market makers in the secondary market.
The notes will mature on September 17, 2001, and carry interest at 7.32 percent per annum payable semi-annually in arrears, the statement said.
